sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed: the national payment network is down and every call from clearing fails or times out. Payments stay pending and the clearing backlog stands at 125 items.
sbar.background: The national payment network, run by another organisation, stopped answering and 100% of requests to it fail. The clearing log shows 'payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=98'.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an external outage of the payment network (confidence 0.93). Item 98 is not poison; it waits only because the network refuses or times out, and the screening-standby restarts were operator and maintenance actions with no symptom. No allowed action fixes this, so the incident commander escalated it to the network operator itself.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the national payment network operator to restore service, and do not quarantine item 98 because it is not malformed. Once the network answers, confirm clearing drains its 125-item backlog. Operations should review the pending payments for delays.
